+def _scan_files(
+    searchpath: t.Iterable[str], followlinks: bool
+) -> t.Dict[str, t.Tuple[int, int, int]]:
+    """Map the absolute path of every file below the search paths to a
+    signature that changes when the file is edited, replaced or
+    resized. Directories that cannot be read are skipped, they look
+    like deleted files to the comparison.
+    """
+    state: t.Dict[str, t.Tuple[int, int, int]] = {}
+
+    for root in searchpath:
+        for dirpath, _, filenames in os.walk(
+            os.path.abspath(root), followlinks=followlinks
+        ):
+            for filename in filenames:
+                path = os.path.join(dirpath, filename)
+
+                try:
+                    stat = os.stat(path)
+                except OSError:
+                    continue
+
+                state[path] = (stat.st_mtime_ns, stat.st_size, stat.st_ino)
+
+    return state
+
+
+def _canonical_template_name(name: str) -> str:
+    """Spell a template name the way the file it names is found, so
+    ``./a//b.html`` and ``a/b.html`` are the same cache entry.
+    """
+    pieces: t.List[str] = []
+
+    for piece in name.split("/"):
+        if piece == "..":
+            if pieces:
+                pieces.pop()
+        elif piece and piece != ".":
+            pieces.append(piece)
+
+    return "/".join(pieces)
+
+
+class _SearchPathMonitor:
+    """Polls the search paths of a :class:`FileSystemLoader` from a
+    daemon thread and reports the files that changed to the loader.
+
+    Polling works the same on every operating system and needs no
+    dependency. The thread only holds the loader weakly, so a loader
+    that is no longer used is not kept alive by it. The thread ends
+    when the loader is collected, when the loader has no environment
+    left to keep up to date, or when ``auto_reload`` is turned off.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, loader: "FileSystemLoader", interval: float) -> None:
+        self._loader = weakref.ref(loader)
+        self._interval = interval
+        self._stop = threading.Event()
+        # The baseline is taken before the thread starts, so a change
+        # made after the first template was requested is never missed.
+        self._state = _scan_files(loader.searchpath, loader.followlinks)
+        self._thread = threading.Thread(
+            target=self._run, name="jinja2-search-path-monitor", daemon=True
+        )
+        # Stops the thread as soon as the loader goes away instead of
+        # at its next poll. The callback does not refer to the loader.
+        self._finalizer = weakref.finalize(loader, self._stop.set)
+        self._thread.start()
+
+    @property
+    def running(self) -> bool:
+        return self._thread.is_alive() and not self._stop.is_set()
+
+    def _run(self) -> None:
+        while not self._stop.wait(self._interval):
+            try:
+                if not self._poll():
+                    break
+            except Exception:
+                # A directory that vanishes or a template that fails to
+                # invalidate must not end the monitoring.
+                continue
+
+        self._stop.set()
+        self._finalizer.detach()
+
+    def _poll(self) -> bool:
+        """Look for changes once. Returns ``False`` once there is
+        nothing left to monitor. The loader is a local of this method
+        only, so it is not held while the thread waits.
+        """
+        loader = self._loader()
+
+        if loader is None or not loader.auto_reload:
+            return False
+
+        if len(loader._environments) == 0:
+            return False
+
+        state = _scan_files(loader.searchpath, loader.followlinks)
+        old, self._state = self._state, state
+        changed = [
+            path
+            for path in state.keys() | old.keys()
+            if state.get(path) != old.get(path)
+        ]
+
+        if changed:
+            loader._on_template_changed(sorted(changed))
+
+        return True
+
